svg.text: AWS, one region, one VPC, three availability zones. Data plane v2 is a new namespace in the same EKS cluster.
api.everruns.com: the one public API (management and sessions)
stateless pods, route by org token
one per AZ, fixed egress IPs
KEDA, for orgs on data plane v1
Cells: StatefulSet, pod + EBS per AZ, gateway on each
Raft replication crosses AZs inside each cell only
one shared pool, KEDA + Karpenter, spread over AZs
traces and search, local index cache
Cells, executors and query pods talk
app.everruns.com (UI) and api.everruns.com (the API) through one load balancer
Edge router: management → server; v2 sessions, SSE, webhooks → the session's cell
Server reads and writes RDS (management, billing, v1 sessions)
Server pushes agent definitions; data plane sends the feed (in cluster)
Raft: leader to replicas across AZs, the only synchronous disk write
Claims and appends between cell pods and executors
Executors unwrap org data keys in KMS
Outbound calls: executor or sandbox → egress proxy → NAT → internet
History, files, prompts and indexes to S3 without NAT
